name: The R Villa Sinabung
bedroomsText: 2, each with a king-size bed (one upstairs, one downstairs)

facts.text: 2 bedrooms, each with a king-size bed, one upstairs and one downstairs, and 2 full bathrooms.
Private pool and a private entrance.
Air conditioning and ceiling fans, WiFi and a smart TV (YouTube and Netflix, no regular TV channels).
Kitchen with dishwasher, stove, blender, kettle, coffee maker and refrigerator.
Hair dryer; linens, towels and beach essentials are provided.
In Sanur on Jalan Danau Poso, about a 10-minute walk to Cemara Beach.
